individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured microscopy images, not a plot of quantitative averages.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrographs, not a graph with error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: The main graphs plot raw scatter data points (red and green) for each time point rather than only a summary curve, and the insets similarly show discrete measured points rather than a single averaged bar/value.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
error-bars-defined.explanation: The inset plots display vertical error bars on the averaged early time-point data, but the caption never states what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, 95% CI) nor the sample size (n) used to compute the average/error, so the error bars are not adequately defined.
